svg.text: Interface board on a full-size (830-point) breadboard · matches WIRING.md and wiring-diagram rev 0.4
header in a41–a50, PCB over the top rails
(− leg to GND rail if electrolytic)
From the car (bench: 12 V supply on T1/T2)
USB-C: unplugged when the buck feeds J1-4
Top + = 12 V (T1), top − = GND. Bottom − = GND. Bottom + stays EMPTY.
Jumper top − ↔ bottom − (col 62). Many full-size boards split the rails at the
middle: bridge each rail across the gap if yours does.
T1 red → top + · T2 black → top − · T5 red → top + · T6 black → top −
T7 sender white → f5 · T3 gauge white → f24 · green insulated
Header in a41–a50 (VDD, GND, SCL, SDA, ADDR, ALRT, A0, A1, A2, A3 — check your silkscreen)
ADDR, ALRT, A1, A2, A3 open. GND col 42: b42 → top − rail (col 38).
IN+ ← top + (col 55) · IN− ← top − (col 57) · OUT+ → J1-4 · OUT− → J1-6
68k g5–g9 · 100k j9 → bottom − · link f9–f10 · 100 nF i10 → bottom −
Not used — Divider B dropped (battery voltage will come from OBD).
47k g24–g28 · 10k j28 → bottom − · link f28–f29 · 10 µF i29 → bottom −
node col 28: h28 → J1-13 (GPIO1) · optional 3.3 V zener node → GND, band on node
3V3 → b41 (VDD) · SDA → c44 · SCL → d43 · GND → top − rail (col 60)
If the I2C scan doesn't show 0x48, swap SDA/SCL.
The 12 V rail must never touch the ADS1115, J8 or the bottom + rail. Check: T1–T2 not shorted · buck OUT+ = 5.00 V · node A = 0 V with T7 open.
